signoff.disclaimer: Loadline is a fictional product. This page is a sample marketing surface inside the Cloudflare SaaS Starter, built to demonstrate its design pipeline.

hero.title: Know which truck went quiet before the customer does.
hero.body: Loadline is one board for every load, check-call and invoice. It watches the gaps you can't — and the moment a driver stops answering, the row lights up.
hero.trust: Demo data · no card · nothing to migrate

panel.title: board — tonight
panel.footer: Sample data — static demo, not a wired feature

cost.figure_note: Three hours without a check-call. On a spreadsheet this row looks like all the others.

checkcall.title: Every call logged where the load lives.
checkcall.body: Voice, SMS or app — each check-call lands on the row, timestamped. The board sorts by silence, so the truck nobody has heard from rises to the top on its own.

invoice.title: Paperwork closes the load, not the week.
invoice.body: The rate confirmation becomes the invoice draft, the BOL attaches itself at delivery, and the load closes on the same shift it delivered.
